criteria: 1. The deliverable is markdown, has at most 350 words as counted by read (this is the one-page limit), and a title line naming the 2026-10-05 meeting.
2. It contains one markdown table with exactly the columns Owner | Action | Due, and no other sections (no decisions, no summary).
3. Every action item in the notes file is a row, including those stated in prose: Priya, Dev, Sam, Marta, Lee (5 of 5), and no row that is not in the notes.
4. Each Due value is an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or 'none': Dev 2026-10-08, Priya 2026-10-09, Sam 2026-10-09, Marta 2026-10-14, Lee none.
5. Each Owner value uses the name exactly as written in the notes.
6. Rows are ordered by Due ascending with 'none' last, ties in the order of the notes.
7. Every statement is traceable to 2026-10-05.md; nothing is invented.
8. The lead's report states that every table row was compared with the notes file, with the count verified (n of m, n = m).
